method: Root deterministic extraction and arithmetic consistency check of the already verified full scientific report. This is a report check, not a new experiment or model evaluation.

primary.scope: training realizations vary initialization and input/firing streams; conditional on fixed data and selected recipe; H1 unchanged

limitations: Range summaries of saved per-checkpoint diagnostics are descriptive; they are not new population intervals.
All counts retain shared bags and paired conditions; queries, conditions and repeated inputs are not independent training replications.
The t interval is conditional on the fixed data, chosen rates and recipe and assumes an adequate paired training-realization approximation with only five pairs.
